title: What Scripture Actually Means by Leadership
caption:
Every version of leadership the culture sells you runs on being in charge. Scripture's version runs on going first into the cost, which is a completely different currency.

He apologizes before anyone else has the courage to. He takes the job nobody's fighting him for, long before he's handed the one everybody wants. He serves the room before he ever tries to run it, because Christ washed feet before He gave a single order. Then he carries what's heavy and lets someone else take the bow.

That's the whole test. Not who's in charge. Who moves first.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
